messages:
Anna Chen: final heads-up — hotfix/169 (memory leak in batching) is scheduled to cut at the 15:00 UTC deploy window (~25m). We need 2x LGTM + green CI before we cut. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/1690
Jason Ortiz: on it, adding reviewers now. pinging @Maya and @Tom for second eyes.
Maya Patel: skimmed, looks small. one nits: can you rename `batch_size_opt` -> `batch_size_hint`? otherwise ok.
Tom Becker: I can take a proper review in ~10m. if it's just a rename + test, should be fast.
Anna Chen: thanks — Jason will push the rename patch. can we wait for unit tests + a quick canary run? ops wants a green canary before full cut.
Jason Ortiz: pushed patch: `git commit --amend` -> force push. CI triggered: https://ci.redwood/s/1690
deploy-bot: Preflight checks: unit tests running, lint OK, security-scan queued.
Priya Singh: +1 on waiting for canary. last time we had a regression when batching change hit peak traffic. canary window is 10m.
Tom Becker: review complete, left one comment about a logging message but not blocking. giving LGTM after Jason addresses it.
Jason Ortiz: fixed the logging nits and pushed.
Maya Patel: LGTM :thumbsup:
Tom Becker: LGTM as well, leaving approving review.
deploy-bot: Canary started for hotfix/169 (canary id c-879). 5-minute traffic ramp. Link: https://ops.redwood/canaries/879
Priya Singh: watching canary metrics — memory looks stable so far. no error spike.
Anna Chen: great — with 2x LGTM + canary green we're clear to cut at 15:00. will trigger release cut at :00.
deploy-bot: Canary complete: success. smoke tests passed.
Maya Patel: quick note — I added a tiny test ensuring KV cache isn't cleared on prefix mismatch. non-blocking.
Jason Ortiz: thanks all. cutting the release now.
Anna Chen: release cut initiated. defer to oncall if any rollback needed. :rocket:
